clay.h, clay_renderer_SDL3.c: nicbarker/clay at e6cc369 (zlib, LICENSE.md). The renderer's include of clay.h made local; nothing else changed.
fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf: from clay's examples/SDL3-simple-demo (Apache-2.0, Google Fonts).
thorvg: not vendored; brew `thorvg` 1.1.3 (MIT), C API `thorvg_capi.h`, built `-Dengines=cpu`: the software engine only (`tvg_glcanvas_create` and `tvg_wgcanvas_create` return NULL).
hershey/futural.jhf, hershey/cyrilc_1.jhf: kamalmostafa/hershey-fonts at 1356bf2 (the Hershey font data: free to use, change and redistribute, acknowledgements with the data; the block is in hershey/README.md). The spike's data only — nothing in the renderer reads it.
tree-sitter/lib: tree-sitter/tree-sitter at v0.25.10 (MIT, LICENSE). `lib/src` and `lib/include` as published, the amalgamation `lib/src/lib.c` unchanged; the wasm store compiles and returns nothing without a wasm engine.
tree-sitter-typescript/tsx/src: the tsx grammar of zed-industries/tree-sitter-typescript at e2c53597d6a5d9cf7bbe8dccde576fe1e46c5899 (MIT, LICENSE), which is the grammar `tree-sitter-languages`' tsx query was generated against: `parser.c` (8.4 MB, generated) and `scanner.c`. `common/scanner.h` is the same commit's, which `scanner.c` includes.
tree-sitter-languages/tsx/highlights.scm: pierredotco/tree-sitter-languages v0.3.0 (MIT, LICENSE), the generated TSX query — anonymous tokens, then the common, TypeScript and JSX fragments in that order, with every token classified. Its Go bindings are not taken. The query is compiled in `terminal/code.c`, embedded by `generator/highlights-header.ts`; the four predicates it uses (`#match?`, `#not-match?`, `#eq?` and their patterns) are evaluated there, and `terminal/test_code.c` fails when the query starts asking for another.
